official_definition: When your Red/Green Spirit attacks, you can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, and during this battle, the opponent can't activate Burst effects. When the specified target is depleted/destroyed, either refresh the attacking Spirit, or, for each symbol the attacking Spirit has, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [True Infinite Flame] or [True Infinite Flame: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [True Infinite Flame]", "give [True Infinite Flame]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
